Author: beerpsi
Name: FF Logs Uploader
Punchline: An unofficial in-game log uploader client for FF Logs
Changelog:
- Create a separate encounter stopwatch instead of hijacking EngageTimer.
- Fix automatic live logging being started when entering duty recorder.
Description: An alternative to the Archon App for uploading logs to the FF Logs service. Basic features are covered: uploading a log, splitting a log file, live logging.
